cities.name: Vienna

interests.name: Imperial Palaces & Gardens 🏰
interests.description: Explore the world-famous Schönbrunn Palace, former summer residence of the Habsburgs, surrounded by vast baroque gardens.

interests.name: Historic Old Town & St. Stephen’s Cathedral 🕍
interests.description: Vienna’s Gothic heart—narrow medieval streets, charming squares and the iconic cathedral with its patterned roof.

interests.name: Museums & Art Culture 🎨
interests.description: One of the largest cultural complexes in the world, blending classical museums, modern art and youth-friendly open courtyards.

interests.name: Riverside Walks & Nature 🌳
interests.description: Danube Island offers miles of calm river paths, cycling routes, nature spots and relaxing views.

interests.name: Elegant Shopping Streets 🛍️
interests.description: Graben and Kohlmarkt mix imperial architecture, cafes and high-end boutiques—perfect for slow walks.

cities.local_food_tip: Classic Austrian meals such as soups, dumplings, potato dishes and traditional pastries — warm, comforting and flavorful. Try iconic dishes like Wiener Schnitzel, creamy Tafelspitz broth, Kaiserschmarrn pancakes and the legendary Sachertorte. Pair everything with a Melange coffee for the full Viennese vibe.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Schönbrunn Palace: Step into imperial Vienna through golden halls and mirror-lined salons. Take time to explore the palace courtyard, as it opens beautifully in the early hours. → 🌳 Gardens & Gloriette Viewpoint: Walk through perfectly shaped hedges and fountains before climbing to the panoramic terrace with one of the city's best views. → ☕ Schönbrunn Café: A cozy stop for a Melange and warm Apfelstrudel, especially if you're recharging before heading into the city center. Afternoon: 🕍 Stephansplatz: A lively hub with buskers, shops and the heartbeat of Old Vienna. → ⛪ St. Stephen’s Cathedral: Marvel at the patterned rooftop and gothic pillars stretching skyward. Climb the South Tower for an intense but rewarding panorama. → 🛍️ Graben & Kohlmarkt: Elegant pedestrian boulevards with luxury shops, baroque façades and patisseries. → 🍽️ Lunch: Try hearty Viennese specialties like dumpling soups, schnitzel variations or sweet pastries at a traditional Beisl. Sunset: 🌅 Belvedere Gardens: Watch the fountains, sculptures and baroque palace glow in warm golden light — a perfect place for slow wandering and photography. Night: 🌃 Museum Quarter: A vibrant cultural zone where teens and travelers chill on modern outdoor loungers. Enjoy cafés, courtyard art installations or youth-friendly classical concerts.

ideas: 🌼 Walks Through Schönbrunn Gardens: Cherry blossoms and tulips line the pathways, perfect for soft spring photography.
🌸 Belvedere Flower Terraces: The gardens burst into color, reflecting in ornate fountains.
☕ Outdoor Cafés in the Old Town: Warm sunny days make patio seating ideal — grab a Viennese pastry and watch the city flow around you.
🌊 Danube Island (Donauinsel) Walks: Cooling breezes, long riverside trails and hangout spots perfect for warm afternoons.
🌅 Evening City-Center Strolls: Vienna becomes magical at twilight, with soft lights shining through historic streets.
🍦 Gelato at Eissalon am Schwedenplatz: One of the city’s classic gelaterias — ideal for cooling off.
🌳 Shade Walks in Prater Park: A huge green escape with forested paths and breezy open spaces.
🍂 Vienna Woods Photography: Trees turn red and gold, creating fairy-tale backdrops and peaceful walking trails.
🥐 Warm Pastries in Traditional Cafés: Escape the chill with strudel, Sachertorte or Kaiserschmarrn.
🖼️ Visits to Albertina & Kunsthistorisches Museum: Perfect cultural hideaways for cooler weather.
🎄 Rathausplatz Market: Enormous, festive and full of lights, sweets and warm drinks.
✨ Belvedere Christmas Village: Romantic ambiance with glowing stalls beneath the baroque palace.
🏰 Maria-Theresien Square Market: A refined market set between two monumental museums.

Sunset: 🌅 Hungerburg Plateau: Watch the city glow beneath golden peaks. Night: 🌃 Cozy Old Town cafés or a peaceful riverside walk along the Inn with mountain silhouettes overhead.
